title: Indexing a mapped range
statement: For a function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\alpha$, a natural number $n$, an index $i<n$, and a default value $d\in\alpha$, the $i$th entry of the list obtained by mapping $f$ over $0,1,\ldots,n-1$ is $f(i)$.
